## Core Focus Areas

- **Deep Learning & Audio DSP**: PyTorch neural networks, STFT, spectral audio processing, neural stem separation.
- **Computer Vision & Robotics**: Real-time object detection (YOLO), OpenCV, ROS (Robot Operating System), autonomous control.
- **High-Performance C++ & Python**: C++17 compute kernels, pybind11 interoperability, vector similarity, native matrix operations.
- **Data Engineering & Interactive Systems**: Statistical analysis, analytical data pipelines, React, Three.js 3D web previewers.

## Key Projects

- [Music2Chart](https://music2chart.adiels.me/): Automated high-fidelity audio-to-chart workstation for Clone Hero and YARG. Translates audio into tournament-grade `.chart` and `.sng` packages with real-time 3D Highway visualization.
- [GitHub Profile (Adiells)](https://github.com/adiells): Open-source repositories and research implementations.
- [Snake AI & Neuroevolution](https://github.com/adiells): Genetic algorithms and neural controllers trained for spatial navigation and real-time decision-making.
- [High-Performance Vector Recommendation Kernel](https://github.com/adiells): Native C++17 compute engine with pybind11 integration for sub-millisecond similarity scoring.
- [Autonomous Robotic Perception](https://github.com/adiells): ROS-integrated visual tracking and obstacle avoidance pipeline for mobile robotics.
